previous_statement: Second obstruction: exact involution preservation. Even after adding epsilon<=e_0/2 and rho<=a_merge=e_0/2, and even conditionally assuming nodes 1.1.1, 1.1.2, 1.2, and 1.3 validated, the factorization establishes that gamma is bijective, gamma_n=I_n tensor gamma, and the amplifications have the asserted approximate unit, multiplication, involution, and two-sided norm bounds. But the allowed source definition of a delta-homomorphism in the *-algebra setting additionally requires the exact identity gamma_n(X^dagger)=gamma_n(X)^dagger. Node 1.2 supplies only ||gamma_n(X^dagger)-gamma_n(X)^dagger||<=K_hom*e*||X||, which does not imply that identity for e>0, regardless of the choice of C_merge. Therefore the amplifications have not been shown to be C_merge*e-homomorphisms, so def-extended-delta-inclusion does not yield an extended C_merge*e-isomorphism. Thus the conditional theorem in node 1.4.1 also requires exact involution compatibility (or a changed target definition), in addition to the missing epsilon-smallness hypothesis; under the allowed inputs, this is an obstruction rather than a proof of the root contract.
new_statement: Symmetrization removes the exact-involution issue. Continue under the conditional hypotheses epsilon<=e_0/2, rho<=a_merge=e_0/2 and conditional validation of nodes 1.1.1, 1.1.2, 1.2, and 1.3, and put e=rho+epsilon. Although the raw assembled gamma need not preserve involution exactly, define the level-one complex-linear map tilde_gamma(x)=(gamma(x)+gamma(x^dagger)^dagger)/2. Its amplifications preserve involution exactly and differ from gamma_n by at most (K_hom/2)e in operator norm. After decreasing the universal e_0, the unit, multiplication, and two-sided norm estimates transfer with universal enlarged constants, and tilde_gamma is bijective by a Neumann perturbation of the bijective gamma. Thus tilde_gamma is an extended C_tilde*e-isomorphism. No additional exact-involution hypothesis is needed for the corrected conditional theorem; the separate missing epsilon-smallness premise identified in node 1.4.1 remains, so this does not prove the root contract as written.
